_doc: Single source of truth for canonical→installed surface mapping. Consumed by runtime-sync.py AND posttool-sync-weigh.sh. Edit HERE, not in consumers.

config._doc: Schema/data files read by INSTALLED runtime scripts (mogul-mandate.schema.json → mandate-write.py fail-closed teeth, /review 598). Scoped to *.schema.json; non-schema config (runtime manifests, examples) stays canonical-only via sync_exclude until a consumer needs it installed. bk-cgg-mandate-schema-install-sync, tic 619.

migrations._doc: Trusted correction-receipt inventory read by INSTALLED effective_record.py (TRUSTED_MIGRATIONS_DIR is script-relative: scripts/lib → parents[2]/migrations). Without this target the installed resolver cannot verify truth-affecting corrections and fail-closed rejects them (unverified_authorization_receipt → hydration-gate rc=2 → session-restore.sh line-156 boot blackout). bk-boot-born-extraction-miss cure leg (a), tic 679.

contracts._doc: F-767-E1 cure (/review 767 wave-5, in-lane per the three-prong hold law): the installed queue-lifecycle-writeback.py had been import-dead since /review 708 because contracts/ was never an install target — enum-as-data contracts (confidence-tier, pending-class, landing-kind) must ride the sync or every installed consumer of them is dead code.

_tracked_external_scripts_doc: Runtime-invokable scripts that live OUTSIDE cgg-runtime/ by intentional placement (e.g., path-locked to a data location). Not subject to ~/.claude install/sync, but registered here so runtime-sync awareness includes them. Declares ownership without forcing relocation. See CogPR for Runtime-Invokable Scripts Must Register in Sync Manifest.
